title: A reminder before a batch expires
description: One notification on the shop's Batch record: 30 days before a batch's expiry date, an e-mail to every holder of the Stock Manager role, in every store, showing the batch's own fields. The shop's daily scheduler sends it; no save of a batch runs it. One message per batch on the day, with no cap and no filter by store. Needs POS build 2.0.0.654 or later; a separate package from S27's alerts, so that S27 still installs on an older shop.
